audit.why: WR 50.81 over 248 games matches an even-to-slightly-favoured read.
Lane difficulty framing (even spell war, win via roams) fits both kits: Azir is weak early, scales into teamfights; Taliyah out-roams.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart holds a blanket 'Skill' on rows 0-4 and 'Azir' on row 6, contradicting both the packet levelChart and the content win[] which say Taliyah on those rows.
audit.why: Azir has the weakest early lane in the kit comparison: soldier costs 70-110 mana on a 14/12/10/8/6s Q, no dash until E (22s CD) which needs a soldier to travel to, no hard CC until 6. Taliyah's Q on fresh ground out-trades every stage; packet and content layers agree.
audit.corrected: phases[0..4].side and phases[6].side -> Taliyah, whys rewritten to match; win[] already correct so no content edits needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; Azir E interaction stated without its 22/20.5/19/17.5/16s cooldown; W-through-E stun mechanic understated.
audit.why: Kit file gives Azir E 22s rank 1, Q 14s rank 1 at 70 mana; Taliyah W 14s, E 14s, Q 7s. Taliyah W knock-through E mines detonates the stun; Azir E is a dash that requires a soldier to reach and grants a brief shield — that shield changes the burst maths if you combo into it.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns; sequencing keyed to Azir E downtime.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere.
audit.why: Azir E at 22s rank 1 is the single punishable window.
audit.corrected: Added 'once he dashes, step up and force the W-E' with numbers.

edits.before: Q on fresh ground shreds level-1 trades — most mids don't expect five stones at minute two. Manage your Worked Ground like mana.
edits.after: Q on fresh ground wins level 1 — Azir's soldier costs 70 mana on a 14s cooldown and his windup is slow, so chunk him at every last-hit.

edits.before: W online: the shove-displacement already threatens kill angles against overstep-happy laners.
edits.after: W online: shove Azir off his soldier when he steps up — he has no dash and no answer until Shifting Sands.

edits.before: Full kit: W-into-E is the signature burst — shove him across the stones and watch half a health bar disappear.
edits.after: Full kit: W-shove him through E mines for the stun — he has no answer until 6; Shifting Sands needs a soldier to reach.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke on every wave contact. Fresh-ground positioning is your real skill expression now.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke every wave contact; his own Q costs 70+ mana a cast, so Azir runs dry answering back.

edits.before: Weaver's Wall online — you are now the best roaming mid in the game. Every shove is a bot-lane gank announcement.
edits.after: Weaver's Wall online — you out-roam him hard, and his Emperor's Divide is spent peeling your W-E here, not killing you.

edits.before: Late Taliyah edits maps: wall their reinforcements, shove their frontline into your team, and Q whatever stands on stones.
edits.after: Two items up you still out-map him: wall his flank, shove his front line into your team — never duel inside a full soldier setup.

edits.before: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Seismic Shove for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — 22s at rank 1, 16s max. Once he dashes, he has no escape for that whole window: step up and force the W-E. - Your W is 14s early — budget it for the combo or a gank, never for poke.

edits.before: Q from fresh ground on his last-hit, and if he steps to answer, W-shove him across the E-field — the full geometry trade is half a health bar.
edits.after: Crash the wave, then wall-surf out — Azir's pre-item clear is slow and he cannot match your river speed, so every crash buys a free gank window.

edits.before: Trading while standing on your own Worked Ground — one-stone Qs lose every exchange your positioning already conceded.
edits.after: W is the only tool that moves Azir off his soldiers and your combo-starter — thrown for chip damage it is gone for 14 seconds.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP doubles the roam thesis; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP extends the roam plan across resets; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.

edits.before: Track Azir’s Shifting Sands: His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Azir’s Shifting Sands: a 22s shield-dash that needs a soldier to reach — once he burns it, the next 20 seconds are your all-in window.

notes: Full-layer level chart carried a blanket 'Skill' 0-4 and 'Azir' on row 6 while the content win[] and packet levelChart both said Taliyah — aligned full to them; win[] edits deliberately omitted because content already agrees (chart rule case 2). Row 5 (Level 6/First item boundary) left as Skill on both layers, matching packet. Taliyah Q kit flag lists 'grounding' — that is a tooltip-parse misfire (Worked Ground); did not assert grounding anywhere.
